{{Top|leg}}
A '''collector coil''' was an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] component applied to a [[Hoersch-Kessel ion drive]]. The coils collected the dangerous [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] emissions from the drive. The coils were then scrubbed and replaced during routine maintenance.
